title: 第二十一章 诡异第二十二章 困局
content_zh:
“玛德！这群畜生！老子非要活剐了他们！”
江飞看着二中教学楼顶站着的女人，恨恨的捏住了拳头；
二中内一片寂静，地面微微蠕动，从破损的地面可以看到，一条条血纹正如蛇一般向外扩散！
“飞哥，这汲血阵真的没办法破坏掉么？”陈芸不甘的问道。
江飞摇了摇头“除非有七境武者”
“或者，第一处阵眼启动的时候，直接不顾后果的将布阵的人斩杀！
但现在说那些也晚了”
江飞的语气有些苦涩，对方的六处阵眼启动的有些脱节；
倘若在一中的阵眼刚刚启动的时候，齐达就不顾一切的斩杀对方可能也就死伤个几千人。
不会酿成现在这么严重的后果
但也怪不了齐达，谁能想到对方要布置的根本就是血祭大阵？
何况，是敌人搞的破坏，你不去怪那些畜生，反过来怪队友心慈手软那不是有病么？
更应该怪的，其实反而是镇武局！
对方在他们眼皮子下面倒腾了这么多年，甚至还有内奸爬上了高位！
专门负责对内的镇武局居然没有一点点察觉？
这是天大的失职！
恐怕，就算他们这次活了下来，也会被送到天外战场填线，战斗到死！才能赎清自己的罪孽
“为什么忽然会这样”陈芸喃喃道；
她发现现在自己什么都做不了；
虽然把从局里带来的碑插在了二中外围，阻挡了血纹的蔓延可也只是降低了蔓延的速度。

局里的人已经做过了详细分析；
倘若没有意外的话，三个小时！
三个小时之后，六处汲血阵的血纹足以蔓延全城！
而后再用几分钟的时间，把晨阳市内的居民抽成干尸
“难道我们就只能看着看着他们”
“小芸”江飞拍了拍陈芸的肩膀，欲言又止。
“如果我们能早几天接手楚元的案子，说不定可以提前发现”
镇武局的业务能力还是不俗的，其实他们已经摸到了严烜不对劲；
只不过还没有来得及动手，就出了这档子事。
二中教学楼顶的那个女人也在情报中，她和严烜有过碰面，本来就是一伙的
陈芸觉得，倘若镇武局早点接手楚元的案子，说不定能提前几天发现严烜；
content_en:
"Mad! These beasts! I must kill them alive!"
Jiang Fei looked at the woman standing on the roof of the No. 2 Middle School teaching building and clenched his fists bitterly;
There was silence in No. 2 Middle School, and the ground squirmed slightly. From the damaged ground, you could see blood streaks spreading outward like snakes!
"Brother Fei, is there really no way to destroy this blood-draining formation?" Chen Yun asked unwillingly.
Jiang Fei shook his head, "Unless there are warriors in the Seventh Realm"
"Or, when the first formation eye is activated, directly kill the people setting up the formation regardless of the consequences!
But it’s too late to say that now.”
Jiang Fei's tone was a little bitter, and the opponent's six formation eyes were a little out of touch;
If Qi Da had just activated the Formation Eye of No. 1 Middle School and killed the opponent at all costs, he might have killed or injured several thousand people.
It will not lead to such serious consequences as it is now
But Qi Da can't be blamed. Who would have thought that what the other party was going to arrange was basically a blood sacrifice formation?
What's more, the destruction was caused by the enemy. If you don't blame those beasts, but instead blame your teammates for being soft-hearted, isn't that sick?
The one who should be more to blame is actually the Suppression and Martial Arts Bureau!
The other party has been lurking under their noses for so many years, and even a traitor has climbed to a high position!
The Suppression and Martial Arts Bureau, which is responsible for internal affairs, didn’t notice at all?
This is a huge dereliction of duty!
I'm afraid, even if they survive this time, they will be sent to the outer battlefield to fill in the lines and fight to the death! Only in this way can you atone for your sins
"Why did this happen suddenly?" Chen Yun murmured;
She found that she could do nothing now;
Although the monument brought from the bureau was inserted outside the No. 2 Middle School, it blocked the spread of blood streaks, but it only slowed down the spread.
People in the bureau have done a detailed analysis;
If there are no accidents, three hours!
Three hours later, the blood patterns in the six blood-draining arrays were enough to spread throughout the city!
Then it took a few minutes to turn the residents of Chenyang City into mummies.
"Can we just watch them?"
"Xiao Yun" Jiang Fei patted Chen Yun on the shoulder and hesitated to speak.
"If we could have taken over Chu Yuan's case a few days earlier, maybe we could have discovered it in advance."
The Suppression Bureau's business capabilities are still good, but in fact they have already sensed something is wrong with Yan Xuan;
But before I could take action, something like this happened.
The woman on the roof of the teaching building of No. 2 Middle School is also in the information. She and Yan Xuan have met before and they were originally a group of people.
Chen Yun felt that if the Suppression Bureau took over Chu Yuan's case earlier, they might be able to discover Yan Xuan a few days in advance;
